title: At the tourist office
instructions: Bir çift turizm danışma bürosunda bilgi alıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; önerileri, fiyatları ve saatleri takip et.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: Hello. We're here for two days. What do you recommend?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Well, the castle is our most famous place. It's open from nine to five.

script.speaker: jen
script.text: How much is it to go in?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Twelve pounds each. But with a City Card, it's free, and buses are free too.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: How much is the City Card?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Twenty-five pounds for two days. It also gives you a free boat trip on the river.

script.speaker: jen
script.text: That's a good price. We'll take two cards.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: Is there a good place to eat near the castle?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, the Old Bridge restaurant. It's famous for fish. But book a table, it's always busy.

script.speaker: jen
script.text: And is there anything to do in the evening?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: There's a free concert in the main square tonight at eight.

questions.prompt: How long are Paul and Jen staying?
What is free with the City Card?
options: the castle, buses and a boat trip
questions.feedback: Kartla kale, otobüsler ve nehirde tekne turu ücretsiz.
questions.evidence: It also gives you a free boat trip on the river.

questions.prompt: How much is one City Card?
questions.feedback: İki günlük kart yirmi beş pound.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about the Old Bridge restaurant?
options: It's always busy, so book a table.
questions.feedback: Balığıyla ünlü ve hep kalabalık; masa ayırtmak gerekiyor.
